messages:
paul: Heads-up — CarePlus POC Android client sees repeated SSE disconnects and 'Unexpected end of JSON input' in logs ~10-20s after connect. Demo blocked. Can we triage? cc @anjali

anjali: Are they routing through a gateway/CDN? Paste a small client log + captured SSE bytes if available.

paul: They're going via their API gateway. Client log:
```
E/SSEParser: JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of input
E/SSEParser: last_chunk='{"note":"Dose change: ta'
```
Raw concat they captured:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"pt":8,"note":"Dose change: ta\n\ndata: ken at 08:00"}}
```

elaine: That looks like the JSON is split across chunks/event boundaries. Common root causes: gateway buffering/rechunking, gzip/recompress, or idle timeouts. Quick mitigations: 1) ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`; 2) disable proxy buffering/enable streaming on gateway; 3) flush per event and add a comment heartbeat (e.g., `: hb\n\n`) every 7-10s so idle timeouts don't close the connection.

anjali: Client-side fallback: aggregate event lines until you see the double newline terminator before calling `JSON.parse`. NDJSON is more robust to chunking but needs client change.

paul: Customer gateway idle timeout = 16s. We'll ask them to enable streaming and set heartbeat <16s. Can we push a temporary heartbeat on our demo service?

elaine: We can toggle a short-lived keepalive for this POC. I'll spin up a patch to emit `: hb` every 8s and ensure flush. ops-bot, file a ticket.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-7788 created and assigned to eng-platform (tag: sse-keepalive).

paul: Thanks — joining their call now to walk through gateway streaming flag. I'll update after we test the heartbeat and confirm Android parser behavior. :thumbsup:
